decisions.reason: As a large established machinery firm with R&D capacity and organisational slack, we would keep this core-adjacent coolant pressure booster because its survival through 2024 suggests results are at or above aspiration and it fits our modular process-media systems strategy.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge because it extends the established coolant-management offering, remained visible after the first market test, and in a growing innovative industry its performance likely justifies continued support despite some uncertainty.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor because it matches our installed-base and material-flow capabilities, and the fact that other nearby variants were pruned while this one remained indicates it is meeting aspirations better than weaker alternatives.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor because it complements the conveyor portfolio, appears to have passed the initial comparison against aspiration levels, and the firm can use its service and engineering resources to improve it rather than exit quickly.
